# 74155 - Dual 2-line-to-4-line decoder/demultiplexer (74156 is equal)

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74155.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74155.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 30 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74155 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74155.png) | ![74155 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74155.png) | ![74155 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74155.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 13 | A | input |  |  | select, common, least significant |
| 3 | B | input |  |  | select, common |
| 1 | 1C | input |  |  | data, section 1: with 1G low the addressed 1Y output goes low when 1C is high (1C is inverted at the outputs) |
| 2 | 1G | enable | low |  | controls pins 7, 6, 5, 4; when not enabled: high |
| 15 | 2C | enable | low |  | controls pins 9, 10, 11, 12; when not enabled: high; data, section 2; acts as a second active-low strobe |
| 14 | 2G | enable | low |  | controls pins 9, 10, 11, 12; when not enabled: high |
| 7 | 1Y0 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | 1Y1 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 5 | 1Y2 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 4 | 1Y3 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 2Y0 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 10 | 2Y1 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 11 | 2Y2 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 12 | 2Y3 | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 1Y0 = NOT(1G' AND 1C AND B'A') | Low when 1G is low, 1C is high and B,A = 0. |
| 6 | 1Y1 = NOT(1G' AND 1C AND B'A) | Low when 1G is low, 1C is high and B,A = 1. |
| 5 | 1Y2 = NOT(1G' AND 1C AND BA') | Low when 1G is low, 1C is high and B,A = 2. |
| 4 | 1Y3 = NOT(1G' AND 1C AND BA) | Low when 1G is low, 1C is high and B,A = 3. |
| 9 | 2Y0 = NOT(2G' AND 2C' AND B'A') | Low when 2G is low, 2C is low and B,A = 0. |
| 10 | 2Y1 = NOT(2G' AND 2C' AND B'A) | Low when 2G is low, 2C is low and B,A = 1. |
| 11 | 2Y2 = NOT(2G' AND 2C' AND BA') | Low when 2G is low, 2C is low and B,A = 2. |
| 12 | 2Y3 = NOT(2G' AND 2C' AND BA) | Low when 2G is low, 2C is low and B,A = 3. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | 74155 has totem-pole outputs; the 74156 is the open-collector version (its electrical figures were not read). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A, B, 2C, 1G or 2G | Y | PLH | 13 | 20 | 2 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A, B, 2C, 1G or 2G | Y | PHL | 18 | 27 | 2 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A or B | Y | PLH | 21 | 32 | 3 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A or B | Y | PHL | 21 | 32 | 3 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| 1C | Y | PLH | 16 | 24 | 3 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| 1C | Y | PHL | 20 | 30 | 3 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |

## Not known

- 74156 (open-collector) electrical and switching figures were not read; this file describes the 74155.

## Notes

With 1C tied to 2C and 1G tied to 2G it is a 3-line-to-8-line decoder, C (1C/2C) the most significant select: C low selects section 2, C high section 1 (function table).

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54155, SN54156, SN54LS155, SN54LS156, SN74155, SN74156, SN74LS155, SN74LS156, bulletin DL-S 7611850 (revised October 1976)](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - book pages 7-175 to 7-177 (PDF pages 174-176); SN74155
